Name: Pack and Preserve
Author: NGaar
Description:
[size=6]Pack & Preserve Mod[/size]

🚜 [b]Enhance your farm's shipping and storage system![/b]

The [b]Pack & Preserve Mod[/b] introduces two new machines to [b]optimize bulk shipping[/b] and [b]extend the shelf life of farm products[/b] in [i]Stardew Valley[/i]. Instead of tossing items loosely into the shipping bin, this mod lets you [b]pack produce into crates[/b] and [b]preserve fish and meat in cans[/b], making your farm operations more structured and immersive.


[size=5]🛠️ Features:[/size]

[size=4]1. Packing Station [/size]

Tired of shipping individual fruits and vegetables? The [b]Packing Station[/b] allows you to bundle farm products into neat [b]crates[/b] for a more efficient shipping experience.

[list=1]
[*][b]Pack 5 units[/b] of [b]fruits, vegetables, forage, artisan goods, and animal products[/b] into sturdy [b]crates[/b].
[*] [b]Pack 15 Coffee Beans[/b] into a [b]crate[/b] for easier bulk shipping.
[*][b]Crates have a higher total value[/b] than selling items individually, rewarding bulk sales.
[/list]
[size=4]2. Canning Machine [/size]

Preserve your farm-fresh products for longer! The [b]Canning Machine[/b] lets you [b]seal fish and meat into durable cans[/b], preventing waste and increasing profit margins.

[list=1]
[*][b]Supports all fish and meat types[/b], preserving them in long-lasting canned goods.

[*][b]Canned products are primarily for shipping[/b], not consumption.

[*][b]Craftable cans[/b] ensure that the system stays balanced.
[/list]
[size=4]3. Box-O-Matic [/size]

A fully automated crafting station designed by Maru to streamline your packaging workflow.
It crafts crates, cans, and other storage components used across this mod — perfect for farmers looking to integrate with Automate and keep their production lines clean and hands-free.
[list=1]

[/list][size=4]🔧 Crafting Recipes:

[/size][b]Packing Station:[/b][i]10x Iron Bar, 5x Refined Quartz, 1x Battery Pack

[/i][i][b]Canning Machine:[/b] [i]10x Iron Bar, 5x Refined Quartz, 2x Gold Bar
[/i][/i][i]
[b]Box-O-Matic:[/b] [i]10x Iron Bar, 5x Refined Quartz, [i]2x Gold Bar, [/i]2x Battery Pack[/i]﻿

[/i][i][i][b]Wooden Crate:[/b] [i]1x Wood = 2 Crates[/i], [i]1x Hardwood = 5 Crates

[/i][/i][/i][i][i][i][b]Cans:[/b] [i]1x Iron Bar = 5 Cans[/i][/i][/i][/i][i][i][i]
[/i][/i][/i]
[size=5]⚙️ Additional Details:[/size]

[s]✔ [b]Stacking & Pricing Logic[/b]: Crates share a general name (e.g., [i]Crate of Wine[/i]), but their prices [b]dynamically adjust[/b] based on the contents.
[/s] [b]✔ Dynamic Crate Naming System[/b]
[list]
[*][b]Crates are now named based on their exact contents.[/b] Instead of generic names (e.g., "Crate of Wine"), crates now display [b]both the category and specific type[/b] (e.g., [b]"Crate of Apple Wine"[/b]).
[*]Supports [b]flavoured artisan goods[/b] such as Wine, Jelly, Pickles, Juice, as well as [b]Dried & Smoked Products, Canned Fish, and Canned Meat[/b].
[*][b]Context tags[/b] are used to automatically recognize items without requiring manual definitions for every individual product.
[*][b]Modded flavoured items are also supported[/b], as long as they use proper context tags.
[/list]✔ [b]No Infinite Packing Loops[/b]: Crates [b]cannot be repacked endlessly[/b], ensuring fair balance.
✔ [b]Flavored Items[/b]: Crates and canned fish adjust their [b]appearance dynamically[/b] based on their contents.
✔ [b]Compatibility[/b]: Works seamlessly with [b]modded meats[/b] and [b]additional produce mods[/b].

[size=5]📩 Unlockable Recipes via Mail[/size]

Blueprints for these machines and related items are [b]sent by NPCs based on your progress[/b]:

📦 [b]Packing Station (From Lewis)[/b]
🔓 [i]Unlocks after earning 10,000 gold, [i]reaching Farming Level 2, [/i]selling 50 items via the shipping bin, and reaching friendship level 2 with Lewis.[/i]

📦 [b]Crate Blueprint (From Robin)[/b]
🔓 [i]Unlocks after receiving the Packing Station blueprint.[/i]

🌳 [b]Hardwood Crate Blueprint (From Robin)[/b]
🔓 [i]Unlocks after the player has chopped 15 Large Stumps.

🥫 [b]Canning Machine (From Willy)[/b]
🔓 [i]Unlocks after earning 15,000 gold, reaching Fishing Level 3, reaching friendship level 2 with Willy, and catching at least 50 fish.[/i]

🥫 [b]Can Blueprint (From Clint)[/b]
🔓 [i]Unlocks after receiving the Canning Machine blueprint, and [i]reaching friendship level 2 with [i]Clint.

📦 [b]Box-O-Matic Blueprint (From Maru)[/b]
[i]🔓 [i]Unlocks after receiving all blueprints, and [i]reaching friendship level 3 with [i]Maru.[/i][/i][/i][/i]
[/i][/i][/i][/i]
[size=5]📝 Future Plans (Maybe!)[/size]

🎨 More crate variations with enhanced textures.

☕ Advanced coffee roasting system with flavored coffee beans.

💐 Bouquets for flowers instead of crates, since packing flowers in boxes doesn’t make much sense.

🥫 Possible rework of canned goods to make them consumable.
